cases.explain: Монассия is in apposition to the nominative subject, so the title царь also stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the meaning 'in the eyes/sight of' governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он поклонялся всему небесному воинству и служил ___.
cases.translation: He worshipped all the army of heaven and served it.
cases.explain: The verb служить (to serve) governs the dative case when indicating the object of service.

cases.sentence: Он приносил своего ___ в огненную жертву.
cases.translation: He offered his son as a burnt offering.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the verb приносил (offered).

cases.sentence: Он общался с вызывателем умерших и ___.
cases.translation: He communed with a medium and a wizard.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case when indicating accompaniment or association.

cases.sentence: Он взял резного идола и поставил его в Божьем ___.
cases.translation: He took the carved idol and put it in God's house.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the meaning of location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Попав в беду, он искал милости у ___ своего Бога.
cases.translation: In his distress, he sought mercy from the Lord his God.
cases.explain: The preposition у (with, from someone) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда он молился, ___ смилостивился над ним.
cases.translation: When he prayed, the Lord had compassion on him.
cases.explain: The subject of the verb смилостивился (had compassion) stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Монассия, царь Иудеи, было двенадцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме пятьдесят пять лет.
reading.question: How old was Manasseh when he became king, and how long did he reign?
options: Twelve years old and reigned fifty-five years
Twenty-two years old and reigned thirty years
Eight years old and reigned forty years
Fifteen years old and reigned twenty years
reading.correct: Twelve years old and reigned fifty-five years
reading.explain: The verse states Монассия было двенадцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме пятьдесят пять лет.

reading.ru: Он отстроил святилище на возвышенностях, которое разрушил его отец Езекия.
reading.question: What did Manasseh rebuild that his father Hezekiah had destroyed?
reading.explain: The text states Он отстроил святилище на возвышенностях — he rebuilt the high places that Hezekiah had destroyed.

reading.ru: Попав в беду, он искал милости у Господа своего Бога и глубоко смирился перед Богом своих отцов.
reading.question: What did Manasseh do when he faced distress?
options: He sought mercy and humbled himself before God
He built more altars to false gods
He asked the prophets for help
reading.correct: He sought mercy and humbled himself before God
reading.explain: The verse says Попав в беду, он искал милости у Господа своего Бога и глубоко смирился перед Богом своих отцов.

reading.ru: После этого он отстроил внешнюю стену города Давида к западу от источника Гихон.
reading.question: What did Manasseh rebuild after his repentance?
options: The outer wall of David's city on the west side of Gihon
reading.correct: The outer wall of David's city on the west side of Gihon
reading.explain: The text explicitly says Он отстроил внешнюю стену города Давида к западу от источника Гихон.

reading.ru: Амон, его сын, стал царем вместо него.
reading.question: Who became king after Manasseh?
reading.explain: The text states Амон, его сын, стал царем вместо него — Amon, his son, became king in his place.

reading.ru: Ломон делал зло в глазах Господа, как и его отец Монассия.
reading.question: What was Amon's behavior like compared to his father Manasseh?
options: He did evil like his father Manasseh
He sought to reform the kingdom
reading.correct: He did evil like his father Manasseh
reading.explain: The text says ОМОН делал зло в глазах Господа, как и его отец Монассия — Amon did evil in the eyes of the Lord, just as his father Manasseh did.
